R_RAW_TRANSFER.name: Deletion-stable raw-length transfer and shared-arm lifting
R_RAW_TRANSFER.remaining: Independent mathematical review, statement-fidelity approval, novelty and significance assessment.

R_NET_LENGTH_ONLY.name: Use only the net projected length as the returned denominator
R_NET_LENGTH_ONLY.reason: The engine charges raw traversals. The exact local correction has raw length 19 and net length 9, so a net-only argument cannot meet this interface.

R_PARTIAL_COPY_DELETION.name: Refute clipping by deleting only one copy of a dead edge
R_PARTIAL_COPY_DELETION.reason: This violates the literal source rule, which removes every mapped copy in family and raw forests. The general commuting identity is formally verified for that rule.

C9000120.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 120 (Almost-linear-time exact matching and prescribed-degree factors in general graphs.; papers: Almost-Linear-Time Maximum-Cardinality Matching in General Graphs; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_MAIN.statement: Manuscript thm:main: one uniform randomized word-RAM algorithm finds an exact maximum matching with probability at least 2/3 and every-path input-size bound C p^(1+eta(p)), eta(p) tending to zero.

C_MAIN_OTHER.statement: Matching-state correctness, projection analysis, uniformization, and witness decoding remain outside this bounded raw-length audit.

C_PRICED.statement: Manuscript lem:priced-steps requires raw-traversal quality, not merely a ratio measured after cancellation.

C_FLAT_INTERFACE.statement: Manuscript engine:flat-quality requires |gamma^T c|/V >= M^(-10/a) OPT with V counting every mapped traversal.

C_MAINTENANCE.statement: Construction costs, adaptive failure probabilities, assignment availability, multiplicity budgets, and persistent recourse are not certified by the raw-length theorem alone.

C_RAW_TRANSFER.statement: For every admissible verified frozen hierarchy, deletion state, and selected-support assignment, the complete one-level raw-length comparison and shared-arm lift hold, with transfer loss at most (2Z+6beta+3)A <= 5ZA, beta=17(p+1), Z=40(p+1).
C_RAW_TRANSFER.remaining: Independent review of the complete geometric, combinatorial, and algebraic argument; publishable-level novelty/significance decision.

C_FROZEN.statement: Fixed endpoint marginals and the verified finite forest family give the full frozen identity and coefficient/residual bounds; deletion of all copies commutes with signed projection.

C_LOCAL.statement: Every local correction is a current circulation with raw traversal length at most beta W, including opposite traversals and logical loops.

C_COMPRESSION.statement: A forest vector with divergence supported at promoted terminals compresses with its net length norm and gradient exactly preserved.

C_HUB.statement: Canonical completion retaining the copied old-edge vector and hub-to-hub new edges uses unit null connectors and costs at most 3||Q||+||N||; the factor three for this specified operation is sharp.

C_LIFT.statement: Shared-arm substitution followed by forest-path reduction preserves signed projection and cannot increase raw mapped length, for all traversal multiplicities and valid null maps.

C_RAW_ALGEBRA.statement: General finite-dimensional signed-projection/deletion, incidence norm, cancellation, and scalar transfer inequalities supporting the complete raw-length theorem.
C_RAW_ALGEBRA.remaining: Independent statement-fidelity review; no reviewer confirmation is inferred from compilation.

C_REDUCTION.statement: Manuscript lem:backend-reduction follows with its literal constants 2ZA, 12ZA, and b^2 from the stronger one-level theorem.

C_RECURSION.statement: Conditional on the stated assignments and lifts at all levels, the one-level comparison yields the raw-score recursion and the factor M^(-10/a); this is not an algorithmic complexity certification.
